moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Matchweek 3 of the Premier League season continues with a Friday night fixture and a packed weekend of games across England.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / Sky Sports

angles.name: Friday Night Football
angles.copy: Premier League football is back tonight! Ipswich Town take on Liverpool at 8pm. Who are you backing for the win? #PremierLeague

angles.name: Super Saturday Matches
angles.copy: Get ready for a Super Saturday of Premier League action! Newcastle v Bournemouth, Man City v Coventry, Hull v Aston Villa and more. What's your top pick?

angles.name: Sunday Showdowns
angles.copy: Sunday's Premier League clashes are big: Everton host Man Utd, and Arsenal face Chelsea. Which London derby will deliver the most drama?

moments.title: Beyoncé's 45th Birthday & B'Day Rerelease
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé turns 45 today and celebrates by rereleasing her 'B'Day' album with a special 20th Anniversary Deluxe Edition.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Queen Bey
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the one and only Queen Bey, Beyoncé! Celebrating with a special 'B'Day' 20th Anniversary Deluxe Edition out today. What's your favourite Beyoncé track?

angles.name: B'Day Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 20 years since Beyoncé dropped 'B'Day'! To celebrate, she's rereleased it with bonus tracks. Time to relive the classics and discover new gems.

moments.title: New Music Friday Releases
moments.blurb: Today's New Music Friday brings fresh albums from Sam Tompkins, Ellie Goulding, Kasabian, and ADÉLA, plus new singles from artists like MISSU, Beth McCarthy, and Beyoncé.

angles.name: Fresh Album Drops
angles.copy: New Music Friday is stacked! Sam Tompkins, Ellie Goulding, Kasabian, and ADÉLA all have new albums out today. What's first on your playlist?

angles.name: Singles Spotlight
angles.copy: From MISSU's debut to new tracks from Beth McCarthy and James Marriott, plus a new Beyoncé single - loads of fresh tunes hit today! What's your favourite new single?

moments.title: Official R&B UK Chart Launch
moments.blurb: The Official Charts Company, in collaboration with Everything RNB, is set to launch the first-ever Official R&B UK Chart next Friday, September 11.

angles.name: New Chart Alert
angles.copy: A history-making moment for UK R&B! The Official R&B UK Chart launches next Friday, Sept 11, giving homegrown talent the spotlight they deserve.

angles.name: R&B Recognition
angles.copy: The Official R&B UK Chart is coming! Dedicated to showcasing the freshest R&B releases, this is huge for the genre. Who do you think will top the first chart?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Launch
moments.blurb: The much-anticipated 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing is set to return with its launch show airing on Saturday, September 19, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly's New Era
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-change! Strictly Come Dancing returns Sept 19 with a brand new hosting trio: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe. Who's excited?

angles.name: Glitterball Season
angles.copy: The pre-recorded Strictly launch is set for Sept 9, airing on Sept 19! The live shows kick off Sept 26. Time to dust off those dancing shoes!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off 2026 Return
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 29, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back
angles.copy: Ready your rolling pins! The Great British Bake Off returns Sept 29 on Channel 4, and Nigella Lawson is joining the judging panel! Who's excited for soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes?

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson as a Bake Off judge? This year's series is going to be delicious! Tune in from September 29. What's your favourite Bake Off moment?

moments.title: Happy 36th Birthday, James Bay
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter James Bay, known for hits like 'Hold Back The River' and 'Let It Go', celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating James Bay
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 36th Birthday to the incredibly talented James Bay! What's your favourite song from the 'Chaos and the Calm' artist?

moments.title: Happy 51st Birthday, Mark Ronson
moments.blurb: Award-winning British-American DJ and producer Mark Ronson, famous for 'Uptown Funk' and his work with Amy Winehouse, turns 51 today.

angles.name: Cheers to Mark Ronson
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to the genius behind so many hits, Mark Ronson! From 'Uptown Funk' to producing Amy Winehouse, his influence is huge. What's your top Ronson production?

moments.title: Happy 59th Birthday, Macy Gray
moments.blurb: Distinctive soul singer Macy Gray, known for her hit 'I Try', will celebrate her 59th birthday on Sunday, September 6.

angles.name: Macy Gray's Milestone
angles.copy: On Sunday, we're wishing a Happy 59th Birthday to the incredible Macy Gray! Her unique voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Macy Gray song?

moments.title: Happy 83rd Birthday, Roger Waters
moments.blurb: Roger Waters, co-founder and driving force behind Pink Floyd, will turn 83 on Sunday, September 6.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 83rd Birthday to Pink Floyd legend Roger Waters this Sunday! Which iconic Pink Floyd album with his influence is your favourite?

moments.title: Happy 75th Birthday, Chrissie Hynde
moments.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday on Monday, September 7.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Rock icon Chrissie Hynde turns 75 this Monday! From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', The Pretenders' legacy is undeniable. Celebrate with us!

moments.title: Happy 47th Birthday, Pink
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning pop-rock superstar Pink, known for her powerful vocals and acrobatic live performances, will celebrate her 47th birthday on Tuesday, September 8.

angles.name: Raise Your Glass for Pink
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Raise Your Glass'! The incredible Pink turns 47 on Tuesday. What's your favourite anthemic track from the pop powerhouse?

moments.title: Happy 66th Birthday, Aimee Mann
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Aimee Mann, known for her solo work and 'Til Tuesday, will turn 66 on Tuesday, September 8.

angles.name: Celebrating Aimee Mann
angles.copy: Wishing a Happy 66th Birthday to the brilliant Aimee Mann this Tuesday! From 'Voices Carry' to her acclaimed solo albums, she's a songwriting legend.

moments.title: Happy 59th Birthday, Harry Connick Jr.
moments.blurb: Multi-talented singer, pianist, and actor Harry Connick Jr. will celebrate his 59th birthday on Friday, September 11.

angles.name: Jazz & Crooner Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a Happy 59th Birthday to the smooth sounds of Harry Connick Jr. this Friday! What's your favourite song from the jazz and swing icon?

moments.title: UK Weather: Mixed but Warmer South
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing mixed weather with rain in the north and west, while the south and east could see drier spells and temperatures potentially reaching 30°C on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Forecast
angles.copy: North-west getting rain, but the South-East could hit 30°C this Sunday! What are your weekend plans, rain or shine?

angles.name: Autumn Heatwave?
angles.copy: Could we be seeing a mini-heatwave in the South this weekend with temperatures nearing 30°C? Enjoy it while it lasts!

moments.title: Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' Re-enters Top 10
moments.blurb: Following her recent passing, Dolly Parton's iconic hit 'Jolene' posthumously re-entered the UK Singles Chart Top 10 this week (week ending Sept 3), 50 years after its original peak.

angles.name: Jolene's Legacy
angles.copy: Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' is back in the UK Top 10 this week! A beautiful tribute to a true legend, 50 years after its original peak. What a song.

angles.name: Chart Comeback
angles.copy: Iconic tracks never die. Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' has re-entered the Top 10 of the UK Singles Chart. A testament to her incredible music.
